items.title: The 1-hour cache duration for prompt caching is now generally available
items.summary: The 1-hour cache duration for prompt caching is now generally available. You can now use the extended cache TTL without a beta header. Learn more in Prompt caching.

explanation.what_it_is: The 1-hour cache duration for prompt caching allows Claude Code users to store prompt results for a longer period, reducing the need for repeated computations.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change allows for more efficient use of resources, as users no longer need to include a beta header to access the extended cache TTL, making it easier to optimize workflows.
how_to_use: Use the extended cache TTL to store prompt results for up to 1 hour, reducing the load on your application
Remove the beta header from your API requests to access the 1-hour cache duration
